subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should `deferred` become a permanent public cron, Gateway protocol, UI/CLI, hook, and plugin SDK contract, or remain an internal waiting state until a final parent result exists?
rationale: The lifecycle bug is concrete, but exposing a new persisted and public status across multiple consumers is a product and compatibility choice that cannot be resolved from implementation correctness alone.

options.title: Keep waiting internal
options.body: Maintain nonterminal internal task/session state and expose only the eventual terminal cron result to public consumers.

options.title: Adopt public deferred
options.body: Accept `deferred` permanently after fresh-install, upgrade, compatibility, and consumer proof is supplied.

options.title: Split public surface
options.body: Land the internal lifecycle repair separately and review the public status and SDK expansion in a follow-up.

recommendation.title: Keep waiting internal
recommendation.body: Maintain nonterminal internal task/session state and expose only the eventual terminal cron result to public consumers.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent cron lifecycle ownership and broad history across the affected task and public surfaces make this the strongest available decision route.
